description: This file contains testing utilities for verifying correct implementation of hash functions in the Abseil C++ library, including functions to check hash consistency with equality, handling of heterogeneous types, and internal hash state comparisons.

classes.name: PrintVisitor
classes.description: Visitor for printing values with index information.

classes.name: EqVisitor
classes.description: Visitor for applying an equality predicate to pairs of values.

classes.name: ExpandVisitor
classes.description: Visitor for expanding values into hash states.

classes.name: TypeSet
classes.description: Template for creating a set of types with insertion logic.

classes.name: MakeTypeSet
classes.description: Helper for constructing a type set from variadic types.

classes.name: VariantForTypes
classes.description: Alias for a variant type over a set of types.

classes.name: ContainerAsVector
classes.description: Converts a container or tuple into a vector of variant pointers for testing.

methods.name: VerifyTypeImplementsAbslHashCorrectly
methods.description: Main function to verify hash correctness over a container of values, with optional custom equality.
